stem_book: A gas expands from 2.0 L to 5.0 L against a constant pressure of 100 kPa. Convert volumes to m³ and find the magnitude of the work done. (a) 400 J (b) 200 J (c) 500 J (d) 300 J
reason: printed key b (200 J) is wrong: |w| = 100 kPa × 3×10^(−3) m³ = 300 J; manifest key d already correct. 'magnitude' added since options are positive (w = −300 J)
